title: BRL-CAD performance summary.json
description: Contract for an immutable per-run summary pushed into data/to_process/<run-id>/summary.json. This file is the single source of truth for the fields the dashboard ingestion and lane processors depend on. If the BRL-CAD runner changes any required shape, bump schema_version and update the relevant lane processor.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the summary was produced (fallback for run.timestamp).

lane_order.description: Optional preferred display order of lanes. Drives the lanes.json manifest when present.

run.description: Run identity and provenance. run.id is the canonical dedup key. A run timestamp is required but may be supplied via run.timestamp or the top-level generated_at (enforced by ingest), so only id is required here.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 run timestamp; drives ordering. Falls back to top-level generated_at.

commit.description: Full source commit SHA (used for commit links).

repository.description: owner/name of the source repo (used for commit links).

workflow_url.description: URL of the source CI run (used for the source link).

lanes.description: Map of lane-name -> lane payload. Each lane processor reads only its own lane.

status.description: Lane status. Compared case-insensitively against PASS/FAIL/SKIP/UNKNOWN.

rows.description: Object rows. Field names per lane: benchmark needs build+vgr; rtcmp_prims needs prim+rays_per_sec(+status); rtcmp_generic uses the perf*/compare_status/perf_delta_percent columns.
